title: Teacher Planner 2026-2027 | Digital Teacher Planner GoodNotes | Fillable PDF + Sticker Pack | Academic Year Planner Instant Download
description:
🌻 The teacher planner that finally keeps up with you — a kawaii digital teacher planner for GoodNotes and Notability built for the full academic year, from the first day of school straight through to summer!

Meet the Digital Teacher Planner 2026–2027, the most complete fillable PDF planner for teachers using GoodNotes, Notability, and iPad — packed with 120 beautifully designed pages in a cheerful Sunflower Studio color theme, with lesson plan templates, grade trackers, parent communication logs, sub plans, and so much more — plus a bonus kawaii sticker pack (200+ stickers, 5 sheets!) to make your classroom planning as joyful as your classroom.

❓ FAQ
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
Q: What grade levels is this designed for?
A: This planner works beautifully for K–12 classroom teachers, including elementary, middle school, and high school. The lesson plan template and grade tracker are subject-agnostic — use however many subjects apply to your teaching situation.

Q: Does this work for substitute teachers?
A: Yes! The Sub Plans Template section is specifically designed so you can prep emergency substitute lesson plans in advance. Fill them in once and you're covered for the whole year.

Q: Can homeschool parents use this?
A: Absolutely! Homeschool educators love this planner. Use the lesson plan templates for your curriculum, the grade tracker for assessments, and the academic calendar for scheduling co-ops, field trips, and learning milestones.

Q: The academic year in my country starts in a different month — will this still work?
A: The monthly calendars run August 2026 – July 2027, which covers the standard US and UK academic year. The weekly spreads and lesson plan templates are structured but date-flexible — just fill in whatever weeks apply to your school calendar.

Q: Does this work on a laptop or desktop?
A: Yes! Open in Adobe Acrobat Reader (free) on any Windows or Mac computer. All fillable fields work, and the hyperlinked tabs navigate correctly.

Q: Can I print this to use as a paper planner?
A: Absolutely! Print at home or at a school/campus print center. The US Letter format prints perfectly on standard paper.

Q: Is the IEP / 504 section FERPA compliant?
A: This planner is a personal planning tool, not a district-managed system. Student privacy is your responsibility as the educator. We recommend keeping the planner on a password-protected device and never sharing files that contain student information.

Q: Is this a physical item?
A: No — this is a digital download only. You'll receive a PDF and ZIP file instantly after purchase.

Q: Can I share this with colleagues at my school?
A: This license is for personal use only. Each teacher should purchase their own copy. Thank you for supporting small creators!

layout_principles: Weekly lesson plan spreads use 5 subject rows (customizable) with morning/afternoon time columns — matches the mental model teachers already use
Grade tracker accommodates up to 30 students with 10 assignment columns per page — covers a full marking period on one spread
Sub plans use a bullet-form structured format — fillable in under 15 minutes for fast emergency prep
IEP/504 accommodation section uses a confidential flag column to remind teachers which pages contain sensitive student data
Seating chart grid provided in two layouts (6×5 and 7×4) to fit most classroom arrangements
Academic year calendar spans August 2026–July 2027 — covers US, Canadian, UK, and Australian academic year formats
Parent communication log uses a contact method column (call / email / note) to support IEP documentation best practices
Professional development log includes 'how I'll apply it in class' column — turns PD notes into actionable planning
teacher_design_notes.color_psychology: Sunflower yellow (#F4C430) is scientifically linked to optimism, alertness, and the serotonin response — ideal for a profession that requires sustained energy and positivity. Stem green (#4A7C59) grounds the palette and evokes growth, which mirrors the core mission of teaching. The Sunflower Studio palette avoids the institutional blues and grays of traditional teacher planners, positioning this product as a joy-forward, premium alternative.
